name: safe-celery-observability
title: 安全 Celery 任务观测
description: 通过 Celery 生命周期 signal 提供最小、安全的 task id/name 日志上下文，不承担业务副作用或启动校验。
scope: backend Celery lifecycle logging context and safe event schema
creator: fx
notes: Execution order 3 of 4. Signals are restricted to safe lifecycle logs; do not use them for startup validation or business side effects.
